tagline: The AI coding playbook, delivered weekly.

crossPromotes.name: EndOfCoding
crossPromotes.relationship: Sister brand in AI development education

crossPromotes.name: Vibe Coding Academy
crossPromotes.relationship: Premium education upsell; newsletter feeds academy enrollment

targetAudience: Software developers (junior to senior) actively adopting AI coding tools like Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, and Windsurf
Engineering managers and tech leads evaluating AI development tooling for their teams
Indie hackers and solo founders using AI to build products faster
Computer science students and career changers entering AI-augmented development
CTOs and VP Engineering researching AI's impact on developer productivity and team structure
coreValueProps: Curated weekly playbook: tested AI coding workflows, prompt patterns, and tool comparisons distilled into actionable advice -- not hype
Practitioner perspective: written by builders who use AI tools daily in production, not journalists summarizing press releases
Career-forward content: covers not just how to use AI tools but how AI is reshaping developer roles, hiring, and team structures
pricingModel: Free weekly newsletter. Revenue through sponsorships from developer tool companies and cross-promotion of Veridux Labs products (EndOfCoding, Vibe Coding Academy, Vibe Coding Ebook). Future premium tier potential for in-depth tutorials and exclusive content.

competitors.name: TLDR AI
competitors.positioning: High-volume daily AI newsletter covering broad AI news, research, and tools. Wide audience (tech workers, not just developers). News aggregation format rather than educational/tutorial. 500K+ subscribers.

competitors.name: The Pragmatic Engineer
competitors.positioning: Premium engineering newsletter by Gergely Orosz. Deep-dive articles on engineering culture, career, and industry. Covers AI occasionally but not the primary focus. Paid model ($15/mo). Authoritative voice in eng leadership.

competitors.name: Bytes.dev
competitors.positioning: Popular JavaScript/web dev newsletter with humor. Covers framework updates, tools, and web dev trends. Light on AI-specific content. Entertainment-forward tone. 200K+ subscribers.

differentiators: Exclusively focused on AI-native development (vibe coding) -- not general AI news or general dev news
Practitioner-written with real code examples, prompt patterns, and tested workflows
Direct pipeline to Veridux Labs education products (EndOfCoding, Vibe Coding Academy) for deeper learning
Covers the cultural and career shift, not just the tooling
Weekly cadence optimized for depth over frequency
